new.story: A German 1 euro cent from 2005: the oak twig that Germany kept from its old pfennig coins, ringed by the twelve EU stars. Germany's euro coins carry a mint letter, and this one is J, struck in Hamburg.
new.notes: Phase 1 by Claude from the owner's close-up of the oak side (2026-10-02, in a white 2x2 staple flip). Resolves request R001 (year was 200?; the last digit reads 5).

source: owner close-up photo in chat 2026-10-02 (oak-twig side, date reads 2005); mint J from ledger request R001
